title: Storylet
description: Metadata for one pre-written scene. Contains no prose: `label` names the Ren'Py label that holds the writing.

id.description: Stable id. Once a storylet is `active`, this must not change.

label.description: Ren'Py label holding the scene. Convention: s32_st_<id>.

title.description: Human title for reports and debug screens.

characters.description: Characters who must be present for this to fire.

location.description: Required location, or null for anywhere.

phases.description: Allowed escalation phases. Empty means any.

tags.description: Content tags, used for the pacing budget report.

priority.description: Hard tier. Only the highest-priority eligible storylets compete.

weight.description: Relative likelihood within a priority tier, damped by repeats.

blockers.description: Any that passes blocks the storylet.

effects.description: Applied after the scene plays. See s32_engine.effects.

outcomes.description: Alternative effect sets the scene's own choices produce, in the order the choices appear. Declare these: a state change that exists only inside .rpy prose is invisible to validation, reachability analysis and simulation, which will then report any content depending on it as unreachable.

grants.description: Knowledge granted. Derived from `effects` when omitted; set it explicitly only when the grant happens inside the .rpy label.

cooldown.description: Minimum days between repeats. Requires repeat_policy != once.

anchor.description: Anchor this storylet belongs to, if any.

summary.description: What this scene is for. Write it.
